conclusion: As of 2026-10-25, all 63 selectable INLONG/_Infinity3DP machine profiles resolve fan_speedup_time=0.5 s, fan_kickstart=0.1 s, fan_speedup_overhangs=false and part_cooling_fan_min_pwm=0. All 46 indexed process profiles resolve seam_gap=0, brim_object_gap=0.1 mm, organic branch diameter=3.0 mm, bridge_flow=1.05 and bridge_density=105%. Bundle versions remain INLONG 01.05.01.29 and _Infinity3DP 01.28.15.24. Fan declarations remain valid; eight fresh native cooling cases pass 84 assertions. Proportional kick-start is 0.1*(60-0)/100=0.06 s for a 0-to-60% increase. Commanded linear-move timing does not measure fan RPM, acceleration or firmware arc timing. Saved projects and custom overrides are outside this static preset audit.
scope: Curated profiles, fan option declarations and emitted cooling behavior as of 2026-10-25; Commanded timing is not measured fan RPM, hardware acceleration or firmware arc timing. User preset/project overrides are outside the profile audit.
